name: Kit · Floating type in a void
description: Studio kit starter: extruded 3D type rises letter by letter out of an endless gradient void (S.studio abstract_void — no horizon, dithered, tinted by the design tokens), settles into a gentle per-letter float with seeded satellite shapes drifting around; soft key + coloured rims, slow push-in with a handheld drift. Glossy / iridescent / chrome / clay / glass. Titles, statements, openers; 16:9 and 9:16 (wraps words in portrait).
